mainEntity.name: How much does blockchain app development cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of blockchain app development depends on factors such as product complexity, blockchain network selection, smart contract requirements, integrations, security needs, and scalability goals. A basic blockchain application may start around $40,000, while advanced platforms with multi-chain functionality and enterprise requirements require a larger investment.
